reopened_reason: EW-RS-071 preflight exposes a hard-carrier geometry asymmetry: 6x3-k4 has only horizontal k=4 winning lines yet already has a nonzero OOO correction.

new_assertions.body: Winning-line orientation-family availability is a finite-board geometric property, not a fixed three-channel invariant: 6x3-k4 has H only because K=4 exceeds board height 3 and diagonals also require unavailable row span.
A general H/V/D-source explanation of OOO is falsified because the horizontal-only 6x3-k4 carrier has five degree-2 contradictions and a 16-dimensional OOO correction.

The cross-k observation must be weakened: OOO persistence across k=3 and k=4 argues against a pure k-1 companion-count primitive, but does not identify orientation-family cardinality as the invariant.

Any surviving common structural explanation should be expressible both on horizontal-only 6x3-k4 and on mixed-orientation carriers, making support/exchange/circuit structure a stronger candidate than simultaneous H/V/D presence.
Orientation provenance remains worth testing as a carrier-specific organizing coordinate, but a passing mixed-carrier orientation summary cannot be promoted as the universal source of OOO.
EW-RS-059 PRIMARY 3x6-k4 and BACKUP 5x3-k4 remain sealed; the orientation falsifier uses only declared discovery carriers and previously frozen evidence.
